body.statement: In the published model of Dwivedi et al., an exogenous quantity is generated independently of all other sources of randomness, equation (4) generates each potential outcome from treatment-indexed exogenous unit and time factors plus exogenous noise, and the model expressly requires the counterfactual at a decision time not to depend on past treatment.

source.locator: published pages 2382--2384: equation (4), Assumptions 4--5, and the displayed data-generating mechanism following them
source.verbatim_statement: Equation (4) represents each potential outcome through treatment-indexed unit and time factors and noise.  The text then states that the latent factors are exogenous and i.i.d.; its ensuing mechanism generates latent factors and noise independently, says that these determine the counterfactuals, and only subsequently initializes and updates the treatment policy from observed data.

attestation.note: Verified against the published article text on 2026-09-08.  The factor/noise generation precedes policy initialization and policy updates, so the source supports the node's exogeneity and no-past-treatment scope rather than merely the displayed equation.
